name: Insomnia: keep the host awake for Claude Code
description: Tells Insomnia on your Windows host when Claude Code in this container is working, so the PC doesn't fall asleep mid-task.

hostAddress.description: Host name (or IPv4 address) the container uses to reach the PC running Insomnia.

bridgePort.description: Port of Insomnia's dev container bridge. Change only if you set bridgePort in Insomnia's config.json.
